about: Captions, chapter chips, question cards, answer lines and cards for the Blue Heart Clinics walkthrough video (record-demo.mjs). It is written as a point-by-point reply to Dell Baines's email: each chapter opens with his own question (quote) and ends with a one-line plain answer. {placeholders} are filled at record time from the live UI (counts) and from the measured waits, so every number shown is real. 'vo' is the suggested voice-over line for narration-script.md (defaults to the caption text). Customer-facing wording is neutral: never name a vendor or the technology (src/modules/medreport/core/wording.ts); the recorder scans every customer-facing string here before rendering. q2.review's {blockedNote} explains the red “Blocked” count when the draft has one.
